channel.title: Rowan Ashgrove · News
channel.description: Updates to Ashgrove: The Hollow Hour and The Fivefold Grimoire books by Rowan Ashgrove.

item.title: Version 1.4.4: make your own apprentice
item.description: New Game opens a character creator: nine ready-made looks, face and feature sliders, skin tones and complexion marks, hairstyles, beards and colours, build and age, spectacles, a name and a voice. Saves carry over.

item.title: Version 1.4.3: a quieter loading screen, truer aim
item.description: A still loading screen (and a fix for a crash some PCs hit while loading), men's clothes that hang right on Rowan and the apprentice, and a casting hand that points where the bolt goes. Saves carry over.

item.title: Version 1.4.2: a smoother start
item.description: The loading screen no longer freezes for seconds at a time: the world is now built a little at a time, so the painting and music keep moving to the title. Loading is a little quicker too. Saves carry over.

item.title: Version 1.4: Act IV, The Wide Sky
item.description: The story goes up onto the high moor: Carn Hollow, Sowilo the sun rune, the gale-wraiths and the Star Tower. The apprentice now arrives in his own clothes and earns the robe; robes that move; a new recorded score; footsteps that follow your feet; an animated title; smoother frame rates. Saves carry over.

item.title: The books, revised
item.description: New Kindle editions of The Unbroken Thread, The Waking Vessel and The Tended Flame, with corrections to the Abundance Sigil example, the Doctrine of Three Notes and the Cut Wick. Rolling out on Kindle over the next few days.

item.title: Version 1.3: the Reach, made real
item.description:
The biggest change yet. The whole Reach now has a realistic look: weathered stone and slate, grass that moves in the wind, real trees, and skies that turn from morning haze to gold to a sky full of stars.
Real animals. Horses, cows, sheep and a donkey in the pasture, pigs in the pen, hens on the green, foxes in the meadow and wolves in the Whisperwood at night. Rowan Ashgrove, remade. A

item.title: Version 1.2: a Reach that lives without you
item.description: Weather: rain, storms with thunder, and mist off the mere. Fishing from the jetty on Stillwater Mere: six fish, some only after dark or under a full moon. Benches that mend you and let the hours pass. Companions: Tom or Ada will walk the Reach with you once you are friends. Bonds: remember what each villager loves and bring it to them. item.title: Version 1.1: Android, magic circles and a dodge roll
item.description:
Ashgrove now runs on Android as well as Windows, and one purchase covers both. The free demo is on Android too.

item.title: Ashgrove: The Hollow Hour is out
item.description: Every clock in Hollowmere stopped at the same hour. The game made from the world of The Fivefold Grimoire is now on itch.io for Windows PC. The free demo has the Prologue and all of Act I, and your save carries over. The full game is R20 (about US$1.10). Play the free demo
